aboutText: Greentastic Pty Ltd is a leading provider of energy-efficient solutions for lighting, hot water, space heating and cooling, and other energy-saving products. Based in West Footscray, we help Melbourne homeowners reduce their carbon footprint while cutting energy bills. Our team delivers personalised climate control solutions across the western suburbs, from split system installs to complete solar panel setups.
servicesText: From air conditioning installation to solar panels and heat pump hot water systems, we maximise your home's energy efficiency while keeping you comfortable year-round.
